tasks.goal: Add 'dist' to DEFAULT_EXCLUDED_CONTROL_PATHS in src/agents/workspace-boundary.ts so build output emitted by npm run build is never hashed or reported as a protected-root change. Add a regression test proving that a newly added dist/ file during a run does not produce a workspace-boundary violation, while a newly added src/ file outside writePaths still does, and that every existing default exclusion remains intact. Preserve fail-closed caps and the .git selective re-inclusion. Do not change the write-path audit or any other guard behavior.
nonGoals: Do not weaken source, design or evidence protection.
Do not change write-path audit semantics.
Do not exclude anything besides the dist build output.
deliverables: dist excluded from the default WorkspaceBoundary protections.
A build-output vs outside-write-path regression test.
Preserved existing exclusions and fail-closed caps.
forbidden: Do not exclude src, design, docs, evidence or Git state.
Do not change the write-path audit.
Do not weaken the 100,000-entry or change caps.
